description: Chromium-based browser with data migration, synchronization, mouse gestures, screenshots, and vertical tabs
notes: Profile data in 'User Data' and downloaded dictionaries are persisted by Scoop
Close Turbo Browser before installing, updating, or uninstalling this package
Use 'scoop update turbo-browser' instead of the built-in updater so Scoop remains the package owner
pre_install: $processes = @(Get-Process -Name 'turbo' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($processes.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Turbo Browser is running. Close it before installing or updating this package.' }

uninstaller.script: $processes = @(Get-Process -Name 'turbo' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($processes.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Turbo Browser is running. Close it before uninstalling this package.' }
